title: Regime-Dependent Growth Enhancement: A Transition Metric Interpretation of the Fugaku-DESI Matter Density Offset
abstract: Reinterprets ~10% matter density offset in Fugaku N-body simulations as transition estimator Delta_F measuring integrated regime transition strength.

efc_context.regime_relevance: Transition band between CMB and galaxy formation regimes

key_results: CMB, DESI/Fugaku, and galaxy regimes all consistent
Density offset reinterpreted as integrated transition strength
